objectives.text: This subpart provides regulations for servicing Business and Industry (B&I) Loans guaranteed prior to October 1, 2020 and B&I CARES Act Program Loans made to support business operations in rural areas.

citations.quote: this subpart is specifically applicable to and only contains regulations for servicing Business and Industry (B&I) Loans guaranteed by the Agency prior to October 1, 2020 and Business and Industry loans under the authority of the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security Act (CARES Act) (Pub. L. 116-136) to provide B&I guarantees for loans needed as a result of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic for working capital loan purposes to support business operations and facilities in rural areas

objectives.text: Subpart D supplements 7 CFR part 4279, subpart C by providing additional requirements and instructions for servicing and liquidating all loans guaranteed under 7 CFR part 4279, subpart C (Biorefinery, Renewable Chemical, and Biobased Manufacturing Assistance Guaranteed Loans).

citations.quote: This subpart supplements 7 CFR part 4279, subpart C by providing additional requirements and instructions for servicing and liquidating all loans guaranteed under 7 CFR part 4279, subpart C.

objectives.text: The paramount objective in considering options at default is providing a permanent cure without adversely affecting the risk to the Agency and the lender.

citations.quote: the prospects for providing a permanent cure without adversely affecting the risk to the Agency and the lender is the paramount objective

obligations.action: Service the entire loan and remain mortgagee and secured party of record notwithstanding another party holding a portion of the loan

citations.quote: The lender is responsible for servicing the entire loan and must remain mortgagee and secured party of record, notwithstanding the fact that another party may hold a portion of the loan.

obligations.action: Provide required approval in writing whenever Agency approval is required
obligations.trigger: whenever Agency approval is required

citations.quote: Whether specifically stated or not, whenever Agency approval is required, it must be in writing.

obligations.action: Report the outstanding principal and interest balance and current loan classification on each guaranteed loan semiannually using LINC or Form RD 1980-41
obligations.trigger: semiannually (at June 30 and December 31)

citations.quote: The lender must report the outstanding principal and interest balance and the current loan classification on each guaranteed loan semiannually (at June 30 and December 31), using either the USDA Lender Interactive Network Connection (LINC) system or Form RD 1980-41

obligations.action: Transmit the annual renewal fee to the Agency in accordance with § 4279.120(b), calculated based on the December 31 semiannual status report

citations.quote: The lender must transmit the annual renewal fee to the Agency in accordance with § 4279.120(b) of this chapter calculated based on the December 31 semiannual status report.

obligations.action: Notify the Agency in writing of any change in the loan classification within 30 days
obligations.trigger: When the lender changes the loan classification in the future

citations.quote: When the lender changes the loan classification in the future, the lender must notify the Agency within 30 days, in writing, of any change in the loan classification.

obligations.action: Consult with the Agency to ascertain how the guaranteed loan is being serviced and that loan agreement conditions and covenants are enforced
obligations.trigger: At the Agency's request

citations.quote: At the Agency's request, the lender must consult with the Agency to ascertain how the guaranteed loan is being serviced and that the conditions and covenants of the loan agreement are being enforced.

obligations.action: Obtain, analyze, and forward to the Agency the borrower's and any guarantor's annual financial statements required by the loan agreement
obligations.threshold: within 120 days of the end of the borrower's fiscal year

citations.quote: The lender must obtain, analyze, and forward to the Agency the borrower's and any guarantor's annual financial statements required by the loan agreement within 120 days of the end of the borrower's fiscal year.

obligations.actor: States, local government, Indian tribes, institution of higher education, and nonprofit organization borrowers
obligations.action: Submit an audit conducted in accordance with 2 CFR part 200, subpart F
obligations.trigger: who meet the Federal awards expended threshold established in 2 CFR part 200, subpart F, during their fiscal year
obligations.threshold: no later than nine months after the end of the borrower's fiscal year or 30 days after receipt of the auditor's report, whichever is earlier

citations.quote: States, local government, Indian tribes, institution of higher education, and nonprofit organization borrowers who meet the Federal awards expended threshold established in 2 CFR part 200, subpart F, during their fiscal year must submit an audit conducted in accordance with 2 CFR part 200, subpart F.

obligations.action: Cooperate with the Agency to rectify the situation if the Agency exercises its right to protect its interests
obligations.trigger: If the Agency exercises this right

citations.quote: If the Agency exercises this right, the lender must cooperate with the Agency to rectify the situation.

obligations.action: Obtain prior Agency concurrence and provide a copy of the modification agreement to the Agency for interest rate reductions
obligations.trigger: upon written agreement among borrower, lender, and holder to reduce the interest rate

citations.quote: The lender must obtain prior Agency concurrence and provide a copy of the modification agreement to the Agency.

obligations.action: Permit increases in interest rates
exceptions: normal fluctuations in approved variable interest rates
unless a temporary interest rate reduction occurred
to change from a variable rate to a fixed rate

citations.quote: No increases in interest rates will be permitted, except the normal fluctuations in approved variable interest rates, unless a temporary interest rate reduction occurred or to change from a variable rate to a fixed rate.

obligations.action: Issue new notes for interest-rate changes

citations.quote: the lender is responsible for the legal documentation of interest-rate changes by an endorsement or any other legally effective amendment to the promissory note; however, no new notes shall be issued

obligations.action: Complete a written evaluation to justify the release and obtain written Agency concurrence in advance of the release
obligations.trigger: If a release of collateral does not meet the requirements of paragraph (a)

citations.quote: If a release of collateral does not meet the requirements of paragraph (a) of this section, the lender must complete a written evaluation to justify the release and obtain written Agency concurrence in advance of the release.

obligations.action: Support releases of chattel collateral exceeding $250,000 and real estate collateral exceeding $500,000 with a current appraisal meeting § 4279.144
obligations.trigger: For a release of collateral request when the Borrower is not in monetary default or liquidation
obligations.threshold: chattel collateral value exceeding $250,000 and real estate collateral value exceeding $500,000

citations.quote: the lender must support all releases of chattel collateral with a value exceeding $250,000 and real estate collateral with a value exceeding $500,000 with a current appraisal on the collateral being released and otherwise meets the requirements of § 4279.144 of this chapter

obligations.action: Request subordination of lien position in writing, including a financial analysis supported by current financial statements less than 90 days old, and obtain written Agency concurrence in advance
obligations.threshold: financial statements less than 90 days old

citations.quote: A subordination of the lender's lien position must be requested in writing by the lender and concurred with in writing by the Agency in advance of the subordination. The lender's subordination proposal must include a financial analysis of the servicing action and be fully supported by current financial statements of the borrower and guarantors that are less than 90 days old.

obligations.action: Alter or approve any alterations or modifications of any loan instrument without prior written Agency approval

citations.quote: The lender must neither alter nor approve any alterations or modifications of any loan instrument without the prior written approval of the Agency.

obligations.action: Obtain Agency written approval for any sale or transfer of corporate stock, which must be to an eligible individual or entity in accordance with § 4279.108(a) and (b)
obligations.trigger: Any sale or transfer of corporate stock

citations.quote: Any sale or transfer of corporate stock must be approved by the Agency in writing and must be to an eligible individual or entity in accordance with § 4279.108(a) and 4279.108(b) of this chapter.

obligations.action: Provide credit reports for each individual or entity owning 20 percent or more interest in the transferee and other requested documentation; obtain written Agency approval for transfers to an eligible borrower
obligations.trigger: All transfers and assumptions

citations.quote: All transfers and assumptions must be approved in writing by the Agency and must be to an eligible borrower. The lender must provide credit reports for each individual or entity owning 20 percent or more interest in the transferee, along with such other documentation as the Agency may request to determine eligibility.

obligations.action: Credit any proceeds received from sale of collateral before a transfer and assumption to the transferor's guaranteed loan debt in order of lien priority before closing
obligations.trigger: before a transfer and assumption

citations.quote: The lender must credit any proceeds received from the sale of collateral before a transfer and assumption to the transferor's guaranteed loan debt in order of lien priority before the transfer and assumption is closed.

obligations.action: Pay any annual renewal fee published in the Federal Register in effect at the time the loan is closed for the duration of the Loan Note Guarantee

citations.quote: The lender must pay any annual renewal fee published in the Federal Register and then in effect at the time the loan is closed for the duration of the Loan Note Guarantee.

obligations.action: Sell or transfer the entire loan without the prior written approval of the Agency (after issuance of a Loan Note Guarantee)
obligations.trigger: After the issuance of a Loan Note Guarantee

citations.quote: After the issuance of a Loan Note Guarantee, the lender is prohibited from selling or transferring the entire loan without the prior written approval of the Agency.

obligations.action: Notify the Agency by submitting Form RD 1980-44 or processing the Default Status report in LINC when a borrower is more than 30 days past due and the delinquency cannot be cured within 30 days, or is otherwise in default of covenants
obligations.trigger: when a borrower is more than 30 days past due on a payment and the delinquency cannot be cured within 30 days or when a borrower is otherwise in default of covenants

citations.quote: The lender must notify the Agency when a borrower is more than 30 days past due on a payment and the delinquency cannot be cured within 30 days or when a borrower is otherwise in default of covenants in the loan agreement by promptly submitting Form RD 1980-44, “Guaranteed Loan Borrower Default Status,” or processing the Default Status report in LINC.

obligations.action: Meet with the Agency and, if practical, the borrower to discuss the situation
obligations.trigger: If a monetary default exceeds 60 days

citations.quote: If a monetary default exceeds 60 days, the lender must meet with the Agency and, if practical, the borrower to discuss the situation.

obligations.action: Perform debt write-downs for an existing borrower where the same principals retain control and decisionmaking authority
exceptions: except as directed or ordered under the Bankruptcy Code

citations.quote: Debt write-downs for an existing borrower, where the same principals retain control of and decisionmaking authority for the business, are prohibited, except as directed or ordered under the Bankruptcy Code.

obligations.action: Obtain Agency written authorization when cumulative total of protective advances exceeds $200,000 or 10 percent of aggregate outstanding balance of principal and interest, whichever is less
obligations.threshold: exceeds $200,000 or 10 percent of the aggregate outstanding balance of principal and interest, whichever is less

citations.quote: Agency written authorization is required when the cumulative total of protective advances exceeds $200,000 or 10 percent of the aggregate outstanding balance of principal and interest, whichever is less.

obligations.action: Liquidate the loan, with Agency consent
obligations.trigger: In the event of one or more incidents of default or third party actions that the borrower cannot or will not cure within a reasonable period of time

citations.quote: the lender, with Agency consent, must liquidate the loan

obligations.action: Submit a written, proposed plan of liquidation to the Agency for approval within 30 days after a decision to liquidate, including the enumerated items
obligations.trigger: Within 30 days after a decision to liquidate

citations.quote: Within 30 days after a decision to liquidate, the lender must submit a written, proposed plan of liquidation to the Agency for approval.

obligations.action: Obtain an independent appraisal report meeting § 4279.144 reflecting fair market value and potential liquidation value
obligations.trigger: If the value of the collateral is $250,000 or more

citations.quote: If the value of the collateral is $250,000 or more, the lender must obtain an independent appraisal report meeting the requirements of § 4279.144 of this chapter for the collateral securing the loan, which reflects the fair market value and potential liquidation value.

obligations.action: File an estimated loss claim once a decision has been made to liquidate
obligations.trigger: When the lender owns any of the guaranteed portion of the loan and the liquidation is expected to exceed 90 days

citations.quote: When the lender owns any of the guaranteed portion of the loan, the lender must file an estimated loss claim once a decision has been made to liquidate if the liquidation is expected to exceed 90 days.

obligations.action: Take action to maximize recovery from all personal and corporate guarantees, including seeking deficiency judgments when there is a reasonable chance of future collection

citations.quote: The lender must take action to maximize recovery from all personal and corporate guarantees, including seeking deficiency judgments when there is a reasonable chance of future collection.

obligations.action: Prepare a final report of loss and submit it to the Agency within 30 days after liquidation of all collateral is completed
obligations.trigger: Within 30 days after liquidation of all collateral is completed
exceptions: except for certain unsecured personal or corporate guarantees as provided for in this section

citations.quote: Within 30 days after liquidation of all collateral is completed (except for certain unsecured personal or corporate guarantees as provided for in this section), the lender must prepare a final report of loss and submit it to the Agency.

obligations.action: Reimburse the Agency for the overpayment plus interest at the note rate from the date of payment
obligations.trigger: If the loss is less than the estimated loss payment

citations.quote: If the loss is less than the estimated loss payment, the lender must reimburse the Agency for the overpayment plus interest at the note rate from the date of payment.

obligations.action: Use reasonable efforts to attempt collection from any party still liable, splitting net proceeds pro rata with the Agency

citations.quote: after the final loss claim has been paid, the lender must use reasonable efforts to attempt collection from any party still liable on any loan that was guaranteed. obligations.action: Submit a default status report when the borrower defaults and every 30 days until the default is resolved or a final loss claim is paid

citations.quote: The lender must submit a default status report when the borrower defaults and every 30 days until the default is resolved or a final loss claim is paid by the Agency.

obligations.action: Apply estimated loss payments first to unsecured principal of the guaranteed portion then to unsecured interest of the guaranteed portion

citations.quote: The lender must apply estimated loss payments first to the unsecured principal of the guaranteed portion of the debt and then to the unsecured interest of the guaranteed portion of the debt.

obligations.action: Service the entire loan and remain mortgagee and secured party of record; keep the entire loan secured by the same security with equal lien priority for guaranteed and unguaranteed portions

citations.quote: The entire loan must continue to be secured by the same security with equal lien priority for the guaranteed and unguaranteed portions of the loan. The unguaranteed portion of a loan will neither be paid first nor given any preference or priority over the guaranteed portion of the loan.

citations.quote: All loan servicing actions under this subpart, except for those identified in § 4287.307(a) through (g), are subject to Agency concurrence. notes: Part 4287 contains multiple subparts with parallel but divergent rules: Subpart B (B&I loans guaranteed before Oct 1, 2020 and CARES Act loans) and Subpart D (Biorefinery/BAP loans). Divergences preserved as written, e.g.: (a) financial statement timing — Subpart B requires annual statements within 120 days of fiscal year end, while Subpart D requires quarterly statements within 45 days and audited within 180 days; (b) default notification timing — Subpart B says notify 'promptly' when >30 days past due, Subpart D adds a 'within 15 calendar days' deadline; (c) interest cutoff — Subpart B uses '90 days from most recent delinquency effective date' for loans closed on/after Aug 2, 2016, while Subpart D uses an 'Interest Termination Date'; (d) collateral release thresholds differ ($250k chattel/$500k real estate in Subpart B vs. cumulative 20% of original loan / $250k appraisal in Subpart D); (e) Subpart D § 4287.358(h) adds a prohibition on borrowers/guarantors remaining involved when the agency takes a loss, absent from Subpart B.
